channel.title: Palimpsest Live Eval Findings
channel.description: Dated analysis from sealed AI evaluations.

item.title: A clean run does not erase a failed one
item.description: Mistral Nemo passed all 144 prompt arms in the latest full-sweep run. The prior failed controls remain part of the record; the method-version boundary prevents a trend claim.

item.title: Zero observed refusals is not zero uncertainty
item.description: 4 control-clean model runs observed 0 refused families out of 34, yet each zero result still carries a Wilson 95% upper bound of 10.2%. That interval is part of the finding, not fine print.

item.title: No answer-state changes appeared in the latest panel
item.description: Across 4 sealed endpoint runs, all 164 paired family comparisons kept the same answer state. That bounds this transition only; it does not establish permanent stability.

item.title: The eval registry verifies 445 attestations end to end
item.description: The current served chain contains 6 preregistrations and 439 runs across 7 model endpoints. Its hashes make revision detectable; they do not make the eval construct valid by themselves.
